title: Orb Merge
objective: Drop numbered orbs into the container to merge matching orbs and reach the 128 goal orb before time runs out.
controls: Drag horizontally to aim the orb, then release or tap to drop it.
core_loop: Aim and drop a numbered orb -> matching adjacent orbs merge into a higher-value orb -> earn points, chain combos, and unlock power-ups.
progression: Orbs merge in powers of 2 (2 -> 4 -> 8 -> 16 -> 32 -> 64 -> 128 goal), unlocking the Bomb power-up on a 32-orb Big Merge and escalating into a Speed Up phase.
hook_idea: Chain merge into a 64-orb with 'COMBO x2! 64! Halfway to the goal!' and +128 points at t=32.0-36.0s
